PAPERS.title: Nitration of Urban PM2.5: A Hidden Driver of Enhanced Human Inflammation.
PAPERS.pm: Personal PM2.5 filters, ~1000 nitrated aromatic compounds quantified by HRMS
PAPERS.n: Longitudinal population exposomics in Beijing resolved roughly 1,000 nitrated aromatic compounds (NACs) on personal PM2.5, at median concentrations above the traditional polycyclic aromatics measured alongside them. Secondary NACs formed by aqueous-phase nitration, represented by 3- and 5-nitrosalicylic acid, carried over 70% of summer NAC exposure, and their associations with lung and systemic IL-6 were 2.1 to 232 times stronger than those of PAHs or gaseous NOx. The upper end of that ratio range is doing a lot of work and no CIs are given; associations are cross-sectional within a panel and NAC exposure covaries with everything else in summer photochemistry. Still the strongest argument this quarter that NOx health effects are partly particle-phase - which means mass-only sensing misses the mechanism entirely.

PAPERS.title: Influence of lung overload and exposure scenarios on recovery following inhalation of an alumina nanoparticle and HCl gas mixture.
PAPERS.pm: Alumina nanoparticles 1-20 mg/m3 co-exposed with 5 ppm HCl, nose-only inhalation
PAPERS.n: Rats inhaled alumina nanoparticles at 1-20 mg/m3 with 5 ppm HCl under two temporal patterns - four consecutive days, or once weekly for eight weeks - with assessment at 1 and 28 days post-exposure. The short scenario produced dose-dependent neutrophilic inflammation that resolved by day 28 with partial clearance recovery; the intermittent long scenario left significantly higher retained lung burdens, reduced clearance and persistent neutrophilia at day 28, with the top dose exceeding accepted overload thresholds but no remodelling or genotoxicity. The abstract gives no burden values or dispersion, so the overload claim cannot be checked against the usual volumetric criterion. The transferable point for exposure science: equal cumulative dose delivered intermittently is not equivalent, which time-averaged occupational metrics assume.

PAPERS.title: Molecular Mechanisms of Indoor Environmental Pollution tt-DDE-Induced Blood Pressure Elevation and the Protective Role of Human-Specific Gene CHRFAM7A.
PAPERS.pm: trans,trans-2,4-decadienal, the dominant aldehyde in cooking-oil fumes, by inhalation
PAPERS.geo: Laboratory (transgenic mice and endothelial cells, China)
PAPERS.n: Cooking-oil fumes are stated here as roughly 90% of indoor particulate emissions, and tt-DDE is their dominant aldehyde. Inhaled tt-DDE raised blood pressure in mice through endothelial damage; CHRFAM7A-transgenic mice resisted the systolic rise and the endothelial dysfunction, with protection traced to STAT3/HO-1 activation, and in vitro tt-DDE drove KLF5 inflammatory signalling via METTL3-dependent m6A modification, reversible by CHRFAM7A overexpression and abolished by HO-1 inhibition. No exposure concentration, duration or blood-pressure magnitude appears in the record, and CHRFAM7A is human-specific, so the transgenic model has no wild-type counterpart. Relevance: kitchen PM sensing conflates mass with a gas-phase aldehyde that may carry the cardiovascular signal.

PAPERS.title: The Human Microbiome in Airborne Particulate Matter-Associated Aging-Related Chronic Diseases: An Evidence-Stratified Review.
PAPERS.pm: Airborne PM (size fractions not separated across the reviewed literature)
PAPERS.n: Evidence-stratified review proposing a PM exposure-microbiome-aging framework across respiratory, gut and skin compartments, with the gut microbiota argued to be the most mechanistically developed interface. The stratification is the contribution: the authors grade epidemiological, animal and multiomics evidence separately rather than pooling them into a single causal story. What it cannot do is quantify anything - no pooled estimates, no dose-response, and the reviewed studies use incompatible PM metrics, so the framework is a research agenda rather than a finding. Carried because microbiome mediation keeps being invoked to explain PM associations that survive adjustment, and because a graded map of where the evidence actually is saves the field repeated litigation of the same weak studies.

PAPERS.title: Heterogeneous Risks of Chemical Components and Sources in Size-Resolved Particulate Matter on Ischemic and Hemorrhagic Stroke.
PAPERS.pm: 41 chemical components and 6 emission sources across 9 aerodynamic size fractions below 10 um
PAPERS.n: Time-series analysis of 58,763 ischaemic and 2,588 haemorrhagic stroke hospitalisations against 41 PM components and six source factors resolved across nine size fractions below 10 um - the finest joint size-composition-source contrast this watch has carried. Ischaemic stroke tracked components below 1.1 um and above 3.3 um; haemorrhagic stroke tracked As, Cu, Fe, Mn, Ni, Pb and PAHs. Coal combustion gave RR 1.05 (95% CI 1.01-1.10) per IQR for ischaemic stroke and industrial emissions RR 1.18 (1.00-1.41) for haemorrhagic, whose lower bound sits on the null with 2,588 events. Source factors from receptor modelling are collinear by construction, so component-specific attribution is softer than the size resolution implies. Size-resolved sensing, not PM2.5 mass, is what this design needs at scale.

PAPERS.journal: Int J Cardiol Cardiovasc Risk Prev
PAPERS.title: Ambient particulate matter exposure and acute type A aortic dissection: A retrospective time-stratified case-crossover study in northern Italy.
PAPERS.pm: Daily mean PM2.5 and PM10 from one urban-background station, same-day and 30-day windows
PAPERS.n: Time-stratified case-crossover of 40 Stanford type A acute aortic dissections at a single northern-Italian centre, 2018-2022, referent days matched on weekday within month and year, temperature-adjusted. A doubling of same-day PM2.5 gave adjusted OR 4.78 (95% CI 1.61-14.29); 30-day PM2.5 and both PM10 windows pointed the same way. Forty cases is the whole story - the interval spans nearly an order of magnitude, the authors label the estimates exploratory, and a single urban-background monitor stands in for everyone in the catchment. Reported here because it is a rare European estimate for a high-lethality outcome, not because the magnitude is credible. This is exactly the low-count, high-misclassification setting where a dense network changes the variance more than the point estimate.

PAPERS.title: Air Pollution Exposure Induces Vascular Endothelial Cell Dysfunction via Elevated Circulating F2: Multiomics Insights from an Ex Vivo Biosensor Assay.
PAPERS.pm: Ambient PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NO2 and CO contrast between two cities, no personal sampling
PAPERS.n: Travel-panel design: eight college students moved from Qingdao to the substantially more polluted Shijiazhuang, with serial serum sampling, proteomics, metabolomics and an ex vivo endothelial biosensor. Prothrombin (F2) emerged as the hub node correlated with exposure and was nominated again by weighted gene coexpression analysis; metabolomics showed bile-acid and arginine-proline perturbation, and endothelial transcriptomes showed activation. n = 8 with no counter-travel arm is the ceiling on all of it - city is confounded with diet, water, sleep and stress, and the omics search space dwarfs the sample. Hypothesis-generating only. The design itself is cheap to strengthen: a personal-sensor-instrumented reciprocal travel panel would give an exposure axis instead of a city label.

PAPERS.title: Joint effects of air pollution and temperature on glycemia: An exposome analysis in European cohorts.
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - air pollution and temperature jointly, metrics not recoverable
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Elsevier deposited title, authors (Jeong, Edstorp, Lovison, Pickford and colleagues) and DOI on 23 Sep with no abstract, and Crossref, Europe PMC and PubMed all returned nothing. The title states a joint air-pollution-temperature exposome analysis of glycaemia across European cohorts, which is a design this watch tracks - temperature is the covariate most likely to be doing the work in short-term PM cardiometabolic associations. Nothing about the pollutants, exposure model, cohorts, sample size or estimates can be stated from the deposit, and inferring a method from a title is not something this watch does. On the retry list; re-screen on its merits when the abstract appears.

PAPERS.title: Association Between Long-Term Exposure to Air Pollution and Parkinson's Disease: Administrative Cohort of Older Adults in South Korea.
PAPERS.pm: District-level annual PM2.5, NO2 and O3 from CMAQ, 1-year moving average, time-varying
PAPERS.n: 5.3 million adults aged 65 and over in the Korean National Health Insurance database, 2010-2019, with 143,557 incident Parkinson's disease cases ascertained from claims requiring hospitalisation or repeated outpatient diagnoses. Per interquartile increase, PM2.5 (4.3 ug/m3) gave HR 1.018 (95% CI 1.008-1.028) and O3 (7.3 ppb) HR 1.019 (1.006-1.033); NO2 was inverse after full adjustment, and no demographic or clinical effect modification reached significance. The inverse NO2 is the tell: exposure is CMAQ output assigned by administrative district, so within-district contrast is zero and urban socioeconomic structure is absorbed into the pollutant. Claims also date diagnosis, not onset. District-resolution assignment at this cohort size is precisely what a dense sensor network would replace.

PAPERS.title: Association of air pollution with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: anemia-related outcomes and exploratory genetic susceptibility analyses.
PAPERS.pm: Residential 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month PM10, PM2.5, NO2, NO, NOx, SO2, CO and O3 at recruitment
PAPERS.n: Taiwan Biobank case-control of 7,566 COPD cases and 22,698 age- and sex-matched controls. Each 10 ug/m3 of PM2.5 carried OR 1.252 (95% CI 1.222-1.283) at a one-month averaging window and 1.642 (1.588-1.699) at twelve months; the within-COPD anaemia analysis showed no consistent association, and a haemoglobin polygenic score interacted with SO2 only nominally. Those confidence intervals are implausibly narrow for 30,000 participants under correlated multi-pollutant exposure, which usually means unmodelled spatial correlation rather than precision, and COPD is defined partly by self-reported emphysema or chronic bronchitis. The monotone rise with averaging window is as consistent with confounding by place as with cumulative dose - a distinction only within-person exposure variation can settle.

PAPERS.title: Real-world PM2.5 exposure triggers early testicular epigenetic responses in the absence of significant changes in measured reproductive endpoints.
PAPERS.pm: Real-world ambient PM2.5, whole-body inhalation, 4, 8 and 12 weeks
PAPERS.n: Male mice breathed real-world ambient PM2.5 in Hangzhou through a whole-body inhalation system for 4, 8 or 12 weeks - roughly one to three spermatogenic cycles. Sperm quality, reproductive hormones, histopathology and oxidative DNA damage were all unchanged, while global testicular 5mC fell at 4 weeks and rose at 12 weeks relative to control (P < 0.05), and 5hmC rose significantly at 12 weeks. The claim is that epigenetic remodelling precedes measurable injury. Two limits: the record gives no exposure concentration, so dose is unquantified, and global 5mC/5hmC has no locus resolution, so a bidirectional time course is as compatible with adaptation as with damage. Real-ambient inhalation studies live or die on continuous characterisation of what the animals actually breathe - an instrumentation problem.

PAPERS.title: Cohort profile: the Shenzhen Birth Cohort (SZBC) study.
PAPERS.pm: Prenatal and postnatal PM2.5 with component resolution (nitrate singled out); model not stated
PAPERS.n: Cohort profile rather than a result: 4,208 women recruited at 19 weeks' gestation or earlier from a single Shenzhen maternity hospital since March 2018, 3,962 with complete baseline data, 3,150 deliveries, up to 20 follow-up points through age seven, with questionnaires, examinations and blood, urine and faecal samples. Findings cited to date include prenatal greenness associated with better motor development and postnatal PM2.5 - nitrate in particular - with delayed motor and problem-solving development. No effect sizes, intervals, exposure model or adjustment set are given, and single-hospital recruitment in a migrant-dense city limits transportability. Carried as infrastructure: a component-resolved prenatal and postnatal cohort with biosamples is the design that could eventually separate nitrate from mass.

PAPERS.title: Within-Year PM2.5 Exposure Structure Provides Mortality-Predictive Information Beyond the Annual Mean.
PAPERS.pm: Daily modelled PM2.5 summarised as the magnitude-rank index (PMRI) alongside the annual mean
PAPERS.n: Preprint. Daily modelled PM2.5 was linked to age-adjusted mortality for 27,289 county-years across 3,064 US counties, 2003-2011. PMRI is the largest k for which at least k days reached k ug/m3 - a scale-free summary of how a year's concentrations are distributed across days. Under county-grouped 10-fold cross-validation, adding PMRI to the annual mean raised held-out R2 from 0.0802 to 0.1391 (delta R2 0.0589, 95% CI 0.0499-0.0677) and reduced RMSE and MAE, holding across geographic, temporal and all six cause-specific splits. It is ecological, unadjusted for county composition, and an R2 of 0.14 remains weak prediction. The relevance is direct: daily-resolution networks carry mortality-relevant structure that annual means discard.

PAPERS.title: Complexation strength between organic carbon and transition metal ions dominates the photochemical conversion of SO2 to sulfates.
PAPERS.pm: SO2 uptake coefficients and sulfate mass on coal-combustion organic carbon under irradiation
PAPERS.n: Photooxidation of SO2 on coal-combustion organic carbon with and without Fe3+, Cu2+ and Mn2+. Steady-state SO2 uptake coefficients spanned (0.39-22.24)e-6 and sulfate masses (2.36-26.05)e-3 mg. Fe3+ was antagonistic while Cu2+ and Mn2+ enhanced both uptake and sulfate yield; absorbance loss and fluorescence quenching confirmed metal-chromophore complexation, strongest for Fe3+, and sulfate mass rose linearly with hydroxyl-radical intensity. The Fe3+ result inverts the usual expectation that iron catalyses sulfate formation, and the proposed reason - iron binds the chromophores that generate the radicals - is testable. Films under laboratory irradiation are not ambient particles and no atmospherically scaled yields are offered. Secondary sulfate is the fraction optical sensors mis-size worst under humidity, which is why formation pathways matter here.

PAPERS.title: Long-term Observations of Fine Particulate Sulfate in Hanoi during 1999-2023: Impact of SO2 Regional Emissions and Monsoon Circulations.
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - fine particulate sulfate time series, 1999-2023
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Elsevier deposited title, authors (Hien, Vuong, Bac, Ha) and DOI on 23 Sep without an abstract; no leg recovered one. A 24-year fine-sulfate record from Hanoi set against regional SO2 emissions and monsoon circulation would be one of the longest speciated series in Southeast Asia, and the title asserts both an emissions and a meteorological attribution. Sampling method, filter protocol, completeness and the size of any trend are all unavailable, and the title is not evidence of what the paper measured. Carried as a placeholder because long speciated records are the only way to validate the secondary fraction that low-cost optical sensors systematically misread. On the retry list.

PAPERS.title: Seasonal variations of aerosol selenium concentrations and oxidation states in central Japan.
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - aerosol selenium concentration and speciation by oxidation state
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Elsevier deposited title, authors (Kagawa, Nagao, Kagami, Kida) and DOI on 23 Sep with no abstract and none recoverable elsewhere. Selenium oxidation state is a coal-combustion and long-range-transport tracer, and a seasonal speciation record from central Japan would bear on transboundary attribution in the East Asian outflow. The deposit says nothing about site, sampling duration, analytical method, detection limits or the size of the seasonal contrast, so nothing quantitative can be reported and the subtopic assignment rests on the title alone. Listed rather than summarised, on the retry list, and to be re-screened on its merits when an abstract appears.

PAPERS.title: Chemical Characteristics, Source Apportionment and Toxic Potential of PM2.5 in Southern Taiwan: Insights from the Kao-Ping Experiment (KPEx).
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - speciated PM2.5 with source apportionment and a toxicity metric
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Elsevier deposited title, authors (Chen, Wu, Hsu, Hsu) and DOI on 23 Sep without an abstract. The Kao-Ping Experiment is a named campaign in southern Taiwan, and the title promises speciation, receptor-model source apportionment and a toxic-potential measure in one dataset - the combination that lets a source be ranked by harm rather than by mass. None of the instruments, campaign dates, factor solution or toxicity assay can be stated from the deposit. Carried because this is the same size-composition-source axis as the stroke record in this issue and would be the natural external check on it. Retry list.

PAPERS.title: Long-term spatiotemporal evolution, relative hotspot persistence, and predictive attribution of PM2.5 across China.
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - gridded long-term PM2.5 with hotspot persistence and attribution
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Elsevier deposited title, authors (Hu, Shi, Zhang) and DOI on 23 Sep with no abstract recoverable from any leg. The title claims three things - long-term spatiotemporal evolution, persistence of relative hotspots, and predictive attribution of PM2.5 across China - of which the middle is the interesting one, since relative hotspot persistence under a falling national mean is what decides whether monitoring networks can be thinned. Dataset, period, grid resolution, attribution method and results are all unavailable. Listed on metadata; re-screen when the abstract is deposited rather than reading the title as a finding.

PAPERS.title: Effect of Skin Types and Microenvironment of Dermal Exposure to Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbon Derivatives and Heavy Metals.
PAPERS.pm: Particle-bound NPAHs, OPAHs and 11 metals adsorbed onto glycerol-trioleate-coated surrogate skin
PAPERS.geo: China (campus indoor and outdoor sites, including dust events)
PAPERS.n: Polyethylene balloons coated with graded doses of glycerol trioleate stood in for oily, neutral and dry skin, then were deployed across four microenvironments to measure adsorption of nitrated and oxygenated PAHs and 11 metals. Adsorption followed first-order kinetics and ranked oily > neutral > dry; it was highest in dusty weather and lowest indoors on campus, with NPAHs exceeding OPAHs in campus air, and metal uptake ordered V > Zn > As > Ti, with Cu detected only during sand-blowing. A coated balloon is not skin - no sebum turnover, no perspiration, no penetration - so these are surrogate deposition rates, not doses. Useful anyway: it quantifies a route that PM mass monitoring ignores entirely, and dust episodes dominate it.

PAPERS.title: A new balloon-borne system for measuring the vertical variability of aerosol optical properties using low-cost sensors.
PAPERS.pm: Sensirion SPS30 low-cost OPC, calibrated to scattering coefficient, Angstrom exponent and effective radius
PAPERS.n: A balloon-borne AeroSonde carrying calibrated SPS30 optical PM sensors was referenced against an Aurora 4000 nephelometer and an LAS 3340 spectrometer to retrieve aerosol scattering coefficient, scattering Angstrom exponent and effective radius, with Pearson r above 0.88. Agreement was best for the scattering coefficient; SAE and effective radius carried substantially larger uncertainty and are honestly restricted to qualitative fine-versus-coarse discrimination. Soundings in June and August 2025 reached 10-27 km at better than 10 m vertical resolution and captured North American biomass-burning plumes and Saharan dust, agreeing with active remote sensing on layer structure and extensive properties at r 0.74-0.81. Two campaigns and no independent in-situ profile leave the intensive retrievals unvalidated aloft. Still the clearest demonstration this quarter that a commodity OPC can do profiling work.

PAPERS.title: A Continuous Virus Aerosol-into-Liquid Sampler (VAiLS) Integrating Twin-Vortex Condensation Growth and Wet-Cyclone Enrichment.
PAPERS.pm: Number-weighted collection efficiency for KCl nanoparticles and MS2/phi6 bioaerosols at 16 L/min
PAPERS.n: A twin-vortex condensation growth unit (5 C preconditioner, wick-wetted chamber at 20-60 C) feeding a wet cyclone grows virus-sized aerosol into micrometre droplets and concentrates them continuously into liquid at 16 L/min. On KCl nanoparticles, number-weighted collection rose from 7.3% for the cyclone alone to 31.0, 64.4 and 70.4% at growth temperatures of 20, 40 and 60 C, independent of inlet humidity across 16.8-71.8%. For viruses the optimum was 40 C (MS2 93 +/- 0.6%, phi6 90 +/- 2.1%), giving infectious concentrations 3.9e3 and 1.2e3 times a BioSampler, with viability above 92% except phi6 at 60 C. Two surrogate viruses on a bench rig say nothing about field backgrounds or enveloped respiratory pathogens. The humidity independence is the result worth carrying: it is the failure mode of every optical bioaerosol channel.

PAPERS.title: Evaluating performance of real-time monitors for quantifying elemental carbon in diesel particulate matter.
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - real-time elemental carbon monitors against diesel particulate matter
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Taylor and Francis deposited title, authors (Parks, Finley, Raj, Wilson) and DOI on 23 Sep with no abstract, and doi.org returned 403 to an automated fetch, so no landing-page recovery either. This is the single most relevant title of the day for the watch - a head-to-head evaluation of real-time elemental-carbon monitors against diesel PM is exactly the reference-grade comparison that underpins occupational black-carbon sensing - and none of it can be reported: no instruments named, no reference method, no bias or precision figures, no exposure range. It is listed, not summarised, and sits at the top of the retry list.

PAPERS.title: Morphology Change of Diesel Exhaust Black Carbon Particles during Humidification and Evaporation.
PAPERS.pm: Metadata only - black carbon particle morphology through humidification and evaporation cycles
PAPERS.n: Metadata-only record: Elsevier deposited title, authors (Liu, Du, Li, Zhang) and DOI on 23 Sep without an abstract. Morphology change of diesel black carbon under humidification and evaporation is the physical mechanism behind humidity-dependent bias in every optical instrument that infers mass from scattering, so the topic is directly load-bearing for low-cost sensor correction - and the deposit gives no technique, no humidity range, no restructuring metric and no numbers. Recorded on metadata with its subtopic taken from the title, flagged for retry, and explicitly not summarised: a morphology claim inferred from a title would be a fabricated result.

PAPERS.title: Research on dust control and ventilation parameter optimization in roadhead mining based on response surface methodology.
PAPERS.pm: Simulated dust mass concentration at return-air-side corners of a heading face
PAPERS.n: ANSYS Fluent simulation of a fully mechanised heading face under long-forcing, short-exhaust ventilation, with a Box-Behnken design over exhaust-duct inlet angle, exhaust-to-forcing airflow ratio, exhaust inlet diameter and forcing outlet diameter. Inlet angle and exhaust diameter dominated the dust field; multi-objective optimisation cut dust mass concentration by 58% at the lower and 34% at the upper return-air-side corner, and a 1:4 scaled physical model reproduced the simulated field to within 5%. The validation is of the flow model, not of the dust reduction in an operating mine - no in-situ gravimetric comparison, no respirable size cut, no worker exposure. Relevance is direct nonetheless: corner accumulation zones are where fixed monitors are not, and a few nodes placed by this simulation would test it cheaply.

PAPERS.title: Salivary 8-hydroxy-2'-deoxyguanosine as a biomarker of oxidative DNA damage in urban outdoor workers exposed to traffic-related air pollution.
PAPERS.pm: Workplace PM2.5 and noise measured with portable instruments; no personal sampling
PAPERS.geo: Not stated (urban street-vending and indoor control workplaces)
PAPERS.n: Cross-sectional comparison of outdoor street vendors against indoor control workers, with workplace PM2.5 and noise logged by portable instruments and salivary 8-OHdG measured by ELISA. Exposed workers had higher salivary 8-OHdG; PM2.5 and BMI were independent predictors in multivariate models while income and education correlated inversely. What the record does not give is the whole quantitative content: no sample size, no effect estimate, no interval, and no city. Saliva sampled once cannot separate chronic burden from that morning's traffic, and the socioeconomic gradient is entangled with the exposure by construction. Carried because the design rests entirely on portable PM2.5 monitors at the workplace, and its credibility therefore rests on a calibration the abstract never describes.

PAPERS.title: PM2.5, O3 and survival gains from China's clean air actions among patients with lung cancer: a 20-year registry-based cohort study in Beijing.
PAPERS.pm: Three-year pre-diagnosis mean PM2.5 and O3 from the ChinaHighAirPollutants reanalysis
PAPERS.n: 172,845 lung cancer patients diagnosed 2003-2022 in the Beijing Cancer Registry, with three-year pre-diagnosis exposure from ChinaHighAirPollutants. Per 10 ug/m3, PM2.5 gave HR 1.111 (95% CI 1.083-1.140) and O3 HR 1.117 (1.070-1.166) for all-cause mortality, with a significant multiplicative interaction concentrated above roughly 105 ug/m3 of O3. Counterfactual simulation against 2013 levels attributed 13,229 avoided deaths over 2016-2022 and a 7.8-month gain in five-year extended expected lifespan - of which rising O3 and the interaction offset about 40%. Exposure is a reanalysis product at residence at diagnosis with no mobility and no treatment covariates, and the survival gains are simulated, not observed. The interaction is the operational point: a PM2.5-only network cannot rank policy benefit in an ozone-rising regime.

PAPERS.title: Contributions of local household fuel burning and regional transport to ambient PM2.5 in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
PAPERS.pm: Survey-based residential emission inventory 1960-2019 with GEOS-Chem normalised marginal attribution
PAPERS.n: A residential emission inventory for the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau rebuilt from survey household-energy data for 1960-2019 and run through GEOS-Chem with a normalised marginal attribution. Residential emissions rose to about 1990 then declined with partial clean-energy transition, dominated by inefficient animal-dung combustion except for SO2, which tracked coal. Residential sources are over 80% of primary PM2.5 emissions on the plateau, yet all local sources explain only 17% of ambient PM2.5 in Tibet against 46% in Qinghai, with South Asian transport supplying 65% of Tibet's annual ambient PM2.5. Survey-derived inventories over six decades carry large unstated uncertainty and the attribution inherits the model's transport errors. The policy implication is sharp and testable with a sparse plateau sensor network: cleaning local stoves cannot fix Tibetan ambient PM2.5.
